scope_summary: Enable owner-bound generic bootstrap confirm for eligible CLEAN accounts while keeping all source-bound and online broker adapters fail-closed.
Serialize confirm with manual writes and account lifecycle changes through account-first PostgreSQL locking and a fresh eligibility read inside the transaction.
Provide permanent operation-scoped confirm idempotency, exact terminal response replay, single-consumption CAS, and stable conflict behavior across preview expiry and normalized-row cleanup.
Revalidate only selected rows, reject stale previews, group by deterministic instrument identity and direction, and replay each group in UTC timestamp and source-row order.
Support complete multi-lifecycle OPEN/REDUCE/CLOSE replay and independent opposite-side positions without implicit netting or duplicate-row suppression.

Apply instrument creation, canonical position events, aggregated event fees, append-only ledger postings, outbox facts, import-row audit links, session completion, and CLEAN-to-MANUAL transition in one transaction.
Return COMPLETED_NOOP for an empty selected set without consuming account eligibility, while consuming the session and permanently preserving its response.
Expose responsive row selection, stable retry identity, confirm controls, and selected-row, position, event, and posting counts in the import UI.
